Results.ReviewText: This is a professional quality weed eater / brush cutter. It comes with everything you'll need to get started except the gas. It has a nice large gas tank so that you can use it for all your yard work chores. It has a nice support handle and a lock out safety trigger. Cranking instructions are easy to follow and the unit cranks quickly. This unit comes with a string trimmer head that holds .090 line and a three blade brush cutting blade that can handle most large weeds and smaller brush. Instructions to change the heads are easy to follow. Assembly instructions are easy to follow and most anyone can accomplish assembly in less than 30 minutes. Only one slight problem that I have with the unit. Most people will not have this problem. The support strap is a little on the short side for someone of my height. (6' 5") Even with the strap fully extended it's still about 3 inches short. Of course this won't bother 90% of the people that use this! All in all a great unit. I would suggest that you purchase the premix gas that Home Depot sells for this unit also. It saves time and you don't have a lot of gas going bad in larger cans.

Results.ReviewText:
Great gas trimmer for the price. It has enough power to cut through light and medium brush. The brush blade can cut through thicker material. It’s a bit heavy (in general, compared to battery/corded trimmers but not compared to other gas trimmers) but the strap helps keep the weight off your arms and the trimmer balanced. 

Assembly was fairly easy even though the parts don’t exactly match the pictures in the sometimes confusing directions. It works fine with my 1:50 gas. Idles fine and needs a little acceleration to get to full power. I first took it through it’s paces with thick grass and vines. The vines and wirey grass didn’t not clog it up much or for long. It was easy to clear jams.

The brush guard blade works well and it does not throw any debris around. With that though, what you cut doesn’t fall down as well as when you use the wire attachment. Switching from blade to wire is pretty easy when you get the hang of it. This trimmer is fairly inexpensive but great for the owner that uses it once every week or so in the growing season. Value is good.

Results.ReviewText: An economical trimmer with some very nice features. It looks like the Badger trimmer is robust in its construction and will last for a long while. The 26cc engine is powerful and the same capacity as mi 10-year old ECHO trimmer. It should be more than adequate for the brush cutter blade to cut through some tough material. The shoulder strap is a nice design with a clever quick release. The instruction manual is just poorly written and does not include a parts list. I think the trimmer spool line could be a bigger diameter than .095" for a trimmer of this capacity. The lower shaft rotates to allow edging easily while still holding the trimmer in the normal position and the unit is well balanced for ease of use. Mine started first time on the 7th pull. If it holds up well long term, this is a good value for this tool.

Results.ReviewText: This is a commercial type trimmer for a home owners use. I chose this Badger grass trimmer and brush cutter for two major reasons first was the power of the 26cc 2-cycle engine and its 6 year homeowner warranty (3 year commercial warranty). A lot of thought went into the design of the Badger straight shaft trimmer. The unit is very light compared to other trimmers where aircraft grade aluminum is used in the construction of the trimmer. The complete weight of the unit is 11 lbs. total.The twin line feeding of the trimmer is a tap-n-go feature which as been improved on by Badger compared to the earlier tap-n-go models. Another unique feature of the line spool, is the easy Twist-n-Load makes the reloading procedure a breeze. Comes with a grass trimmer head, a brush cutter head and a shoulder harness to balance the unit when using for added comfort. In my opinion this is probably the best string-trimmer on the market. There would not be a 6 year warranty on homeowner use if it was not one of the best trimmers on the market.

ClientResponses.Response:
Dear Valued Home Depot Customer, 
 
We have reached out to the manufacturer and their reply is, We appreciate your feedback however some clarification seems to be in order. The Badger WB26BCI is without doubt a commercial grade product based on several key engineering facts. First the engine is a full crank engine with a chrome lined cylinder and all ball and roller bearing construction and tested to over 150 Life Hours! Second the Badger uses the universal attachment system and accepts ALL attachments from brands that use that system. Your “Popular Brand” unit most likely uses a proprietary attachment system and therefore does not fit on to any Universal System product regardless of brand. Universal System brands include Ryobi, Toro, Troy Bilt, Poulan, Poulan Pro, Weedeater and Craftsman. (Craftsman uses powder coat on their attachments and are a snug fit). Overall Badger is designed to deliver and does deliver a tremendous value to the homeowner and the landscaper. Of course we are always looking for feedback and appreciate you purchasing a Badger product.

Results.ReviewText: The Badger string trimmer is ok. It has ok power and started fairly east once fueled with proper gas mix and primed. However...it seems to have a little bit of a problem with power when compared to my brand name grass trimmer. This grass trimmer is also a slight bit heavier than my popular brand name trimmer. The attachments I have do not seem to fit on this string trimmer that is a big minus in my eyes. I will keep this as a string trimmer only. I will repair my other brand name trimmer to use attachments. The only part of this string trimmer that I find "heavy duty" is the attachment collar on the shaft. BUT due to the fact that popular attachments do not seem to fit..I have to say that it is not worth it. I recommend this string trimmer ONLY if you want a cheap dedicated string trimmer to use at your home. NOT recommend this string trimmer for commercial use or any use that involves using popular attachments.

309475184.Description: The Wild Badger Power Straight Shaft 2-in-1 Grass String Trimmer and Brush Cutter is a versatile, powerful tool. This multi-tool has a grass trimmer attachment for detail work along borders and a brush cutter blade for heavier grasses and brush clearing. This tool includes a harness to relieve the strain on your arms and improve stability. The full crank engine reduces emissions, increasing fuel efficiency and delivering longer life. The transmission is supported by a vented aluminum casing which greatly reduces vibration allowing you to work in comfort until the job is done. The attachment capable straight shaft is built with a robust aluminum tube and connection point which is lightweight and durable. The tap-and-go trimmer head with easy load allows for quick line feed for the twin line cutting system. Replacing the line will no longer eat up precious daylight and will give you more time to get your lawns and landscaping looking clean. Notes about the product: This machine takes a mix of both gasoline and oil, other attachments and accessories not included.
